# Test images

Five correctly classified examples selected from the held-out flower_photos test split. These are integration fixtures, not an accuracy benchmark.

Source: https://storage.googleapis.com/download.tensorflow.org/example_images/flower_photos.tgz

License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/
